sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Vintage Anti-Tarnish Gold Green Dial Beaded Bracelet Watch for Women
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Make a statement with this Vintage Anti-Tarnish Gold Bracelet Watch, featuring a rich emerald green dial and a bold polished bead bracelet. The deep green dial beautifully contrasts with the luxurious gold-tone finish, creating an elegant vintage-inspired look.
The oversized round bead bracelet gives this watch a unique jewellery-like appearance, while the compact rectangular-oval dial adds a sophisticated touch. Perfect for women who love distinctive accessories that combine the elegance of a watch with the charm of a statement bracelet.
Product Highlights
- ✨ Vintage-inspired jewellery watch
- 💛 Anti-tarnish gold-tone finish
- 💚 Rich emerald green dial
- 🟡 Stylish polished bead bracelet design
- 🕰️ Elegant numeral hour markers
- ⌚ Quartz movement
- 💎 Unique watch + statement jewellery design
- 👗 Easy to pair with ethnic and western outfits
- 🎁 Beautiful gifting option for women
- ✨ Perfect for parties, outings and special occasions
Perfect For
Festive occasions, weddings, parties, date nights, casual outings, office looks and gifting.
Care Tip: Keep away from perfumes, water, excessive sweat and harsh chemicals. Store in a dry place when not in use to help maintain the finish.
